what: Alibaba runs China's largest online marketplaces (Taobao and Tmall), a leading Chinese cloud business, international e-commerce sites and logistics.
customers: Chinese shoppers and the merchants who pay to reach them, plus cloud customers.
money: the largest part and most of the profit
moat: A vast base of buyers and sellers and the largest cloud platform in China.
risks: Fierce price competition in Chinese e-commerce
